prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe draws the yellow card out of the window and brings it low over the felt to the middle in front of her, where her other hand takes it by its edges and carries it on low over the felt, yellow side up, to its place in the middle of the picture, where the last frame shows it. There her thumb slides under the long edge nearest it and lifts it as her wrist turns thumb side up; the card rolls over on its opposite long edge, which stays on the felt, and her thumb comes over onto the blue face. Then the hand that laid it glides back low over the felt, palm down, to where it lay in the first frame, and the hand that gave it goes back to the shoe and takes the next card. Only one card moves. The card is plain, one flat solid yellow from edge to edge on its back and one flat solid blue from edge to edge on its face, and the next card in the window is the same plain solid yellow.
